policy: Actual allocator null alone is recoverable. Only LUA_ERRMEM returned by a completed protected operation sets lua_memory_failed; never reset within the owner.
allocator: allocate keeps quota exhausted distinct and unchanged; actual realloc null does not set terminal state, allowing emergency GC retry.
restricted_pcall: Common native protected_call persists LUA_ERRMEM before testing exhaustion and rethrowing. All enclosing restricted wrappers include lua_memory_failed and cannot return to user code.
callback_reference_ownership: register_external keeps descriptor/function references in native vector ownership before allocating Lua calls, selects trivial original-entry token before references, and checks exhausted before selecting or clearing tokens. No callback/selector change required.

host_calls.policy: Protected native tag operations; any nonzero status throws existing resource diagnostic through native exception adapters. No Lua caller resumes; no independent status injection.
Preserves instruction priority; existing memory resource adapter additionally recognizes the sticky bit after nested wrappers rethrow as ordinary Lua error.
exhausted includes sticky bit; resource check precedes bridge/protocol checks; catch renders retained entry outside Lua. No later collection/sealing occurs.
All host calls check exhausted or direct LUA_ERRMEM before nonmemory statuses; existing diagnostics and priorities retained.
Existing native-error precedence preserved; exhausted/direct memory follows; profile-owner invocation still refuses before services.

first_failure: The one actual failing projection2 reference leaves its token. Nested wrapper immediately rethrows; enclosing wrappers preserve sticky bit; host reports resource before protocol or later error. Token is never cleared on this path.
controls: Actual allocation refusal and successful retry tested separately from retained quota and throwing-allocator probes. Descriptor reference grows; function-reference-only fixture has zero growth and is source/control coverage only.
